justification: Decouple Granny Flat to the working async pipeline. The brief's inline GF timed out at 30s (the Modal structure scan needs ~90s) and emitted empty; now the frontend GrannyFlatCard fires the same gated /api/satellite/granny-flat route the standalone tool uses — which gates on SEPP cl 50/53 BEFORE the GPU scan (so an ineligible lot like E1 costs nothing and shows a cited reason), runs the real Modal detection, and is polled. The brief's inline _fetch_granny_flat_detect is no-op'd so Modal isn't double-charged.

pre_impl.existing_data: The working route contract (verified): POST {address,action:'detect'} -> {ineligible,error,evidence} (SEPP cl 50/53 gate) or 202 {jobId}; GET ?jobId= -> {status:'detected'|'completed', data:{samgeo_structure_count,sepp_eligible,sepp_ineligible_reason,lot_area_m2}} | {status:'error'} | {status:'pending'}. The brief streams a satellite.granny_flat section the card hooks onto.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The inline 30s run could never finish the ~90s Modal scan, so GF was always empty; the fix reuses the proven async path instead of the inline call.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the existing /api/satellite/granny-flat route + granny_flat_reports poll contract verbatim (the contract the standalone reports/granny-flat page already uses). New: a GrannyFlatCard that drives that flow inside the brief, wired to the satellite.granny_flat section.
pre_impl.external_source_error: All fetches are wrapped: a POST failure or ineligible response or poll error/timeout each render a distinct honest card (cited ineligible reason / 'couldn't complete'). No throw escapes.
pre_impl.frontend_type: GfState is a discriminated union; the poll uses a cancelled flag + bounded 90 attempts; tsc --noEmit passes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: GF always 'Not run'/empty even when ticked + eligible. After: an ineligible lot shows the cited SEPP reason instantly (no GPU); an eligible lot shows 'analysing…' then the real building count + secondary-dwelling eligibility.

functions.name: GrannyFlatCard
functions.input: the resolved address and whether satellite analysis was requested for this run
functions.output: a card that fires the gated detect route, polls the report, and renders ineligible/result/error/analysing states
functions.if_none: when satellite was not requested or no address, it shows the 'tick Include satellite analysis' prompt

values: N/A - no hardcoded regulatory values. The eligibility gate + cited reasons come from the route (SEPP cl 50/53) and the structure count from the Modal scan.
queries: N/A for new queries - reuses the existing /api/satellite/granny-flat route and its granny_flat_reports poll; the brief backend removes a call (no longer runs detect_structures inline).

break_it.scenario: Modal is off so the scan returns no structures
break_it.what_happens: showing a fake '0 buildings' would be dishonest
break_it.repro: the result card shows the count only when present and always leads with the SEPP eligibility from the route; a null count renders 'Building scan complete' not '0'
break_it.how: count is rendered conditionally; eligibility (the cited, deterministic part) is always shown

break_it.scenario: The lot is ineligible (e.g. E1 commercial)
break_it.what_happens: running the GPU scan would waste cost
break_it.repro: the route returns {ineligible:true} before firing Modal; the card shows the cited reason + evidence
break_it.how: the gate runs server-side before the scan; the card never polls in this case

break_it.scenario: The component unmounts or address changes mid-poll
break_it.what_happens: a late setState on an unmounted component or a stale result
break_it.repro: the effect sets cancelled=true on cleanup and re-keys on [active,address]
break_it.how: every async path checks cancelled before setState

break_it.scenario: The brief still runs GF inline and double-charges Modal
break_it.how: the inline Modal call is removed; only the frontend card fires the scan

break_it.repro: the loop is bounded to 90 attempts (~3 min) then shows a 'timed out — try again' card

post_merge.other_repo: N/A - same Railway process; MODAL_STRUCTURES_URL confirmed ON by the owner so real structure counts return. The satellite-job-runner Trigger.dev task (plotdetect-agents) relays the detect in prod.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief with satellite on: an E1 lot shows a cited 'secondary dwellings not permitted' card instantly (no scan); a residential lot shows 'analysing…' then the real building count + SEPP eligibility. No double Modal run.
